metadata.title: Classifying Leibniz racks
metadata.abstract: Lie quandles were defined by T. Fritz as a nonlinear generalization of Lie algebras, to serve as a nonlinear algebras of observables in generalized form of Hamiltonian mechanics. These objects were subsequently generalized in a prequel article to objects referred to as smooth Lie group families of smooth racks by the authors. In this article, we investigate a particular system of nonlinear functional differential equations whose solution in general provides a pathway to the classification of smooth Lie group families of smooth rack structures on any given smooth manifold. We then discuss a particularly practical ansatz for solving these equations, and use it to construct new families of examples, as well as prove a result on the sense in which the Bloch sphere is the unique Lie quandle structure on the sphere.

analysis.progressType: 光滑 rack 结构的分类工具
analysis.workSummary: 研究用于描述给定流形上光滑 rack 结构的光滑 Lie 群族的一组非线性泛函微分方程，并提出便于求解的 ansatz 来构造新例。还在某种精确意义下证明 Bloch 球面给出的 Lie quandle 结构具有唯一性。
techniques: 光滑 Lie 群族与 rack
analysis.breakthrough: 为这类非线性可观测代数的分类提供方程化路径与可操作的新例生成方法。
analysis.limitations: 摘要描述的是通向分类的方法，不能读成完成任意流形上所有 Leibniz rack 的分类；Bloch 球面唯一性的等价关系与限定条件需查正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
